Exclusive feature

Create a test without an account.

Share one link. Students enter their details and take a timed, auto-graded test. You download a ranked Excel sheet. Free, with no sign-up for anyone.

Create a guest test No sign-up needed
  1. 1
    Build the test
    Type questions, paste AI-generated JSON or upload a file. Pick the student fields you need.
  2. 2
    Share the link
    Send it on WhatsApp or anywhere. Students fill the form and start.
  3. 3
    Download results
    Open your private results link and export the ranked sheet.
No account for you
Build and publish a test without signing up. No institute code, no approval, no waiting.
No account for students
Students open your link on any phone, fill a short form and start. Nothing to install.
You choose what to collect
Name, roll number, class, phone, email, or any custom field. Mark each one required or optional.
The full exam engine
Countdown timer with auto-submit, negative marking, custom marks and question shuffle.
Anti-cheat built in
Tab switches and reloads are warned, logged, and the test auto-submits after 4 strikes.
Answer key stays private
Answers never reach the student’s browser. Grading happens on the server.
Ranked Excel in one click
A private results page with scores, ranks and your info columns, ready to download and share.
Nothing is kept
Every test, answer and result is permanently deleted at midnight IST. No student data lingers.

Guest tests are same-day only. Download your results before midnight IST, when everything is deleted automatically.
